title: Compound Builder · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Compound Builder · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Write six common word parts such as sun, flower, rain and bow. The lead combines the parts to make two familiar compound words. Both combinations are recognizable compound words. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Compound Builder, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
Both combinations are recognizable compound words.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: Both combinations are recognizable compound words.
